question: Under what conditions can yogins access the formless meditation of the goddess?
premises: The meditation is inaccessible to yogins in general.
It can become accessible through difficult means.
Those means include many practices beginning with tranquility.
inference: Though generally inaccessible to yogins, this meditation becomes accessible through many difficult practices such as tranquility.
plain_english: It is inaccessible to yogins, yet accessible through many difficult practices beginning with tranquility.
